The long-awaited virtual reality fantasy game has been released! 

The last man of Joseon, aka Jomaja, Boryeong, dreams of doing all sorts of things he can't do in reality, so much so that he even bought an adult expansion pack, But what the heck?! \[Job: Barmaid\] He finished his first job advancement without even a tutorial?! So what will he become? A seductive male prostitute who will rock the world. I was confused for a moment, wondering if it was a mistake.This really suits me?! It's a fantasy world filled with NPCs who are no different from electronic dildos anyway, so what's the problem with showing off some hidden talents?

Play a virtual reality game filled with lewd desires! \[Would you like to start?\]
